paragraphs.text: Last Saturday was Sports Day in Candy Town. The sun was bright and warm. All the children were very happy. They went to Sugar Park with their parents.
paragraphs.translation: 上周六是糖果镇的运动会。阳光又亮又暖。孩子们都特别开心。他们和爸爸妈妈一起去了糖果公园。

paragraphs.text: There were many games on the green grass. Tom was fast in the running game. Lily jumped over ten big candy boxes. She was the winner of that game.
paragraphs.translation: 绿草地上有很多游戏。汤姆在跑步比赛里跑得飞快。莉莉跳过了十个大糖果盒。她是那个比赛的冠军。

paragraphs.text: At noon, everyone had a big lunch. They ate long candy bread and sweet cakes. The lemon juice was cold and sweet. The children loved it very much.
paragraphs.translation: 中午，大家都吃了一顿丰盛的午饭。他们吃了长长的糖果面包和甜甜的蛋糕。柠檬汁又凉又甜。孩子们特别喜欢。

paragraphs.text: In the afternoon, the parents played a funny game. They walked with a candy on a spoon. Everyone laughed and cheered for them.
paragraphs.translation: 下午，爸爸妈妈们玩了一个好玩的游戏。他们用勺子托着一颗糖果走路。大家一边笑一边给他们加油。

paragraphs.text: Then a kind man gave each child a gift. It was a box of candy. The children smiled and said thank you. They wanted to come again next year.
paragraphs.translation: 后来，一位好心的叔叔给每个孩子发了礼物。那是一盒糖果。孩子们笑着说了谢谢。他们都想明年再来。
